questions.answer: An iterable can produce an iterator, whereas an iterator keeps track of iteration state and yields values one at a time.

questions.answer: Space complexity measures the amount of memory an algorithm uses relative to the input size.

questions.answer: The time complexity of DFS is O(V + E), where V is the number of vertices and E is the number of edges.
